diagnosisReview.reason: sealedArchiveReplaceGenesisV8 reseals only genesis. validateSealedArchiveV8Plan authenticates that envelope and then calls sealedArchiveVerifyGenesisLinksV8 before constructing the store. The link check compares genesis.OriginalV1 with intent.Payload.Core.OriginalV1 and returns conflict before the later reconstructed-byte identity comparison.

expectationOnlyAssessment.whyCoverageIsIncomplete: The valid plan executes the comparison only on its non-error path, while other ReconstructionFailed tests exercise store validation, canonicalization, command/approval integrity, limits, or history. They do not present a fully authenticated linked chain whose claimed OriginalV1 identity disagrees with reconstructed bytes.

steps: Keep all three existing genesis-only mutations and change their expected error to CodeArchiveConflict.
Add a test-only helper that decodes the real plan and derives keys from archive.meta.
Apply the same OriginalV1 identity mutation to intent.Payload.Core.OriginalV1 and genesis.Payload.OriginalV1.
Recompute the core canonical bytes, migration ID and epoch with the existing production functions.
Rebuild and reseal the intent with sealedArchiveMakeIntentV8.
For every candidate, replace migration ID and epoch, rebuild/reseal with sealedArchiveMakeCandidateV8, regenerate its content name, and collect ordinal candidate links.
Replace genesis migration ID, epoch, intent reference, candidate links and OriginalV1; rebuild/reseal it with sealedArchiveMakeGenesisV8 and regenerate its content name.
Run the real validateSealedArchiveV8Plan for the same three length/zero-digest/one-byte-digest mutations and require CodeArchiveReconstructionFailed.
recommendedRepair.receiptReason: The targeted strict identity gate occurs before receipt decoding. The mutation helper must construct the exact authenticated prefix through genesis and reconstruction; rebuilding receipt and fixed-point byte accounting would be unrelated test complexity.
recommendedRepair.coverageResult: Both layers remain proven: genesis-only repeated-identity mismatch is Conflict, while an authenticated synchronized chain with a false OriginalV1 claim reaches and rejects at strict byte proof as ReconstructionFailed.

rejectedRepair.proposal: Extract sealed_archive_a0.go lines 543-545 into a private pure helper and test only that helper
rejectedRepair.reason: It changes product code solely for testability and proves only a trivial length/hash predicate. It does not prove validator ordering, intent/candidate/genesis authentication, linked-identity closure, or that the real plan validator reaches the strict proof branch. A real-chain test is feasible with existing production constructors, so extraction is unnecessary.
